varieties.name: Mchicha (local green)
varieties.supplier_notes: Standard Kenyan green mchicha; fast turnover.

varieties.name: Red Amaranthus
varieties.supplier_notes: Red-leafed; higher iron; premium niche markets.

timeline_template.description_en: Plough fine; incorporate 1 ton manure per acre.
timeline_template.description_sw: Lima vizuri; changanya tani 1 ya samadi.

timeline_template.description_en: Broadcast or drill seed at 1cm depth, 25cm row spacing. Cover lightly.
Thin to 10cm between plants. Thinnings are edible.
timeline_template.description_sw: Punguza mimea iwe na umbali 10cm. Iliyovutwa ni chakula.

timeline_template.description_en: Apply 25kg CAN. Fast-growing crop responds quickly.
Cut whole plant 5cm above ground OR pluck top leaves repeatedly.
timeline_template.description_sw: Kata mmea wote cm 5 juu ya ardhi AU chuna majani ya juu.
timeline_template.tip_en: Repeated leaf-picking yields 3-4 cuts per planting.
timeline_template.tip_sw: Kupluck majani kunatoa mavuno 3-4 kwa upandaji mmoja.

timeline_template.description_en: Continue plucking every 7-10 days for 4-6 weeks.

post_harvest.grading_criteria: Bunch by stem length 25-30cm. Reject yellowed or insect-damaged.
post_harvest.packaging_standard: Tied bunches sold same-day at local market.
post_harvest.storage_tips_en: Sell same-day. Sprinkle with cold water under shade to delay wilt.
post_harvest.storage_tips_sw: Uza siku hiyohiyo. Nyunyizia maji baridi kivulini.

diseases.symptoms_en: Colonies curl new growth; honeydew on leaves; check undersides of young leaves.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Makundi yanakunja majani machanga; utomvu majani; chunguza chini ya majani.
diseases.treatment_en: Squash early colonies; registered products only if spreading. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Ponda makundi ya mwanzo; nyunyuza tu ikiwa yanaenea. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Weekly underside scouting, natural enemies first.
diseases.prevention_sw: Chunguza chini ya majani kila wiki, maadui wa asili kwanza.
diseases.scanner_notes: Underside photo with the colony visible.

diseases.symptoms_en: Silvery winding tunnels through the leaf; cosmetic but costly at market.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Michirizi ya fedha ndani ya jani; hudhuru sura sokoni.
diseases.treatment_en: Remove and destroy mined leaves; registered products at threshold only. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Ondoa majani yaliyoathirika; dawa tu wakati wamezidi. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.scanner_notes: Backlit photo shows the tunnel track.

diseases.symptoms_en: Seedlings collapse at the soil line, brown pinched stems, in wet spells.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Miche huanguka kwenye uso wa udongo, mashina meusi, mvua nyingi.
diseases.treatment_en: Seed-dressing where wet; no rescue for collapsed patches. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa ya mbegu sehemu zenye unyevu; hakuna uokozi wa mapande yaliyoanguka. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Raised beds, thin sowing, well-drained nursery.
diseases.prevention_sw: Vitanda vilivyoinuliwa, panda kidogo, kitalu kisicho na maji.
diseases.scanner_notes: Photograph a whole patch — the pattern is the diagnosis.

market_notes.sell_windows_en: Weekly leafy harvest — the closest crop in the catalogue to a salary. Same-day selling; demand never pauses.
market_notes.sell_windows_sw: Mavuno ya majani kila wiki — zao lililo karibu na mshahara. Uza siku hiyohiyo; mahitaji hayapumziki.
market_notes.price_notes_en: 20–40 KES per bunch retail (November 2026). Multiple ratoons from one sowing.
market_notes.price_notes_sw: KES 20–40 kwa fungu rejareja (Novemba 2026). Vivuno kadhaa kutoka kupanda mara moja.
